objective.name: read.state
objective.description: Return a runtime snapshot of the current context: identity, trace settings, wrapper states, and family states.

#root.role: Snapshot selected local runtime facets of the current context and return one aggregated state payload.

include.description: Explicit allow-list of sections to include. Valid values: 'context', 'trace', 'wrappers', 'families'. When absent, all four sections are included.

context.description: Identity fields of the current context, sourced from the live frame.

fields.context_name: string — short name from context.json brique.context_name
fields.ctx_ext_name: string — extended name from context.json brique.ctx_ext_name
fields.context_dir: string — absolute filesystem path of the context directory

trace.description: Current trace settings from the live frame.

wrappers.description: Snapshot of all wrappers registered in the current frame, sorted by name. Each item describes one wrapper process.

item_fields.name: string — wrapper name
item_fields.pid: integer — OS process ID (0 if not running)
item_fields.ready: boolean — whether the wrapper is ready to handle requests
item_fields.building: boolean — whether the wrapper is currently building
item_fields.starting: boolean — whether the wrapper is currently starting
item_fields.build_at: string — RFC3339Nano UTC timestamp of last build, empty if never built
item_fields.started_at: string — RFC3339Nano UTC timestamp of last start, empty if never started
item_fields.ready_at: string — RFC3339Nano UTC timestamp when last became ready, empty if never ready
item_fields.last_exit_at: string — RFC3339Nano UTC timestamp of last exit, empty if never exited
item_fields.stop_requested_at: string — RFC3339Nano UTC timestamp when stop was requested (field absent if no stop was requested)
item_fields.last_error: string — last error message (field absent if no error)
item_fields.ready_error: string — readiness error message (field absent if no readiness error)

families.description: Runtime lifecycle state of each family registered in the current context.
families.keys: Family name string. Known families: 'communication', 'execution', 'matter', 'trace', 'reflexive'. Only registered families appear.

values.description: Lifecycle state string derived from shared.FamilyState.String(). Possible values:
values.initializing: family loop started, not yet running

families.empty_case: Empty object when no families are registered in the current context.

effects.runtime_snapshot: Live frame and runtime state are read (read-only).

transformation_contract.morphing: A local state query becomes an explicit runtime snapshot of the current context across four orthogonal facets: identity, trace configuration, wrapper process states, and family lifecycle states.
invariants: read.state is strictly scoped to the current context. It does not access child context runtimes.
When params.include is absent, all four sections are included: context, trace, wrappers, families.
Unknown include keys are silently ignored.
All sections reflect live frame state at the moment of execution.
success: Returns a payload containing only the requested sections.
Each section reflects the current live runtime state of the context.
failure: Fails only when frame access required for the requested sections cannot be completed.
